seasonal_note: Seasonal context: November and early December reflect pre-Christmas wholesale giftware stocking, which lifts weekly revenue and order volume well above early-autumn baselines.

show_work.definition: Gross revenue minus the value of cancelled (returned) lines.
show_work.caveats: Returns are booked in the week of the cancellation invoice, not the week of the original sale.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'

drivers.total_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS current, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS previous, COUNT(*) AS rows_scanned FROM lines WHERE ((invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28') OR (invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'))

summary.text: During the retail week of 2011-11-21, net revenue reached £295,233, representing a week-over-week decline of -20.0% compared to £369,129 in the previous period. Performance was also down against the prior four-week average of £310,450, marking a -4.9% variance. Total orders dropped to 616, down -10.3% from 687 the prior week, while average order value fell to £490.90, reflecting a -9.6% decrease from £543.20. Despite these contractions, orders remained +4.1% above the four-week average of 592. The primary revenue drivers for the week were the Christmas category and sales originating from the United Kingdom, which generated £259,185.03 despite a prior period total of £317,151.2. Overall, the week experienced broad downward adjustments across primary revenue and average order value metrics following previous levels.
